coordinatorSummary: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX, with no advisories. Fifteen attacks run, none landed. Custody holds: v2 at a51644fe and frozen v1 at 4a2cf4d3, both 0444 and unmoved, dispatch and prompt agreeing, HEAD never left c2b77f6, file 08 at 3a9442d1 equal to the subject's own pin, governing tree clean, and all five recordedInputs reproduce, now including v1 itself. Both v1 findings land in a single obligation and I verified every clause of it in source rather than in the disposition block. OBL-DR125-ACTIVATION is leftoverDesign false at activation-gate-at-DR-125, filed alongside the DR-119 and DR-006 rides — the shape I asked for. Its reason cites v13's matrixShape.dr125ActivationGate, which says matrix authoring waits on DR-125's closure or disposition, and D-007's OBS-T2-02 routing; both are faithful. It records DR-125 as OPEN and D-110's candidate as CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED binding NOTHING, which D-110's adopted entry and component-sdk-contract.v4's own header both bear out, and DR-125's live row is still OPEN so the gate is genuinely shut. The concrete harm I named is closed: proposedLaterWork item 2 now says the matrix and corpus may be authored only after DR-125 closes or is disposed, and refuses applying D-110. The change is additive — one obligation, no removals, leftover set unchanged at three, ten-way partition with no overlap — and everything I praised at v1 survives, including the Class B token treatment and the G13 obligation's empty namedIdentifiersNotAuthored list, which remains the most precise handling of a reserved-not-named gate in this series. One note on classification, recorded as considered and declined: the new obligation is not leftover, and that is right — DR-125's closure is DR-125's design work, and filing it as DR-118 leftover would have inflated this row's remainder with another row's obligation. Finally, worth recording: both reviewers raised this gap independently against v1, mine from v13's field and D-007's routing, Codex's adding the D-110 dimension. On a series where we have mostly caught different things, this is the first clean convergence.
